description: Set the daily public-post and/or engagement-like cap for an X account (main or pool). This is the only place these volumes can be set — they are a per-account safety ceiling shared by every agent/campaign that uses the account, never per-agent or per-workspace.

x_ld_like_daily_limit.description: Max engagement likes this account may send per day (0-2000).

x_ld_public_daily_limit.description: Max public quotes/replies this account may post per day (0-500).

name: admin__set_x_account_daily_limits
